name: Lemos Bassai
source:
King of Juvion, the Allied Pacific Kingdom, which consists of the North and South Pacific territories. Logical and dry-witted, Lemos is pleasantly surprised at Nova's resourcefulness, considering his largely impatient personality. Because of his previously failed marriage, Lemos feels that he is not cut out for relationships. He cites as proof his deteriorated relationship with his ex-wife, the former queen, which was a massive failure on his own part (and... he's not totally wrong on that point.)

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=36495]Lemma Soft Forum[/url]]
